{{Current events|year=2019|month=03|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**Seven people are moderately injured after a rocket attack destroys a home in [[Mishmeret]], [[Israel]]. The [[Israel Defense Forces]] claim that [[Hamas]] is responsible for any attack from Gaza. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47689684 (BBC)]
**As a result, [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] cuts his four-day trip to the United States short after meeting with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/netanyahu-cuts-short-u-s-trip-after-rocket-attack-from-gaza-idUSKCN1R60M3 (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/gaza-rocket-hits-israeli-home-injuring-7-netanyahu-cuts-short-washington-trip/2019/03/25/7eb5f062-4ed0-11e9-a3f7-78b7525a8d5f_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**In retaliation [[Israeli Air Force]] jets strike multiple targets in the [[Gaza Strip]], including the office of senior [[Hamas]] official [[Ismail Haniyeh]], and Hamas' military intelligence headquarters in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palsetinians-violence-haniyeh/israel-air-strike-targets-office-of-hamas-leader-in-gaza-hamas-radio-idUSKCN1R62BJ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/israeli-military-begins-striking-hamas-targets-gaza-190325152429228.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Iran Floods|2019 Iran floods]]
**[[Flash flooding]] in the southern provinces of [[Iran]] kills at least 19 people and injures more than 100. The majority of the deaths occurred in the city of [[Shiraz]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47694423 (BBC)]

;Health and environment
*[[Bayer]] and [[Johnson & Johnson]] announce that they have reached a $775 million agreement to settle approximately 25,000 outstanding litigation cases, which claim that their drug [[Xarelto]] caused severe and sometimes fatal bleeding episodes. Bayer and Johnson & Johnson had successfully defended the safety of the drug in all six prior cases that went to trial. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/25/health/xarelto-blood-thinner-lawsuit-settlement.html (''The New York Times'')]

;International relations
*[[United States recognition of the Golan Heights as part of Israel]], [[Israel–United States relations]], [[Syria–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs a proclamation formally recognising the disputed [[Golan Heights]] as sovereign [[Israel]]i territory. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/trump-formally-recognises-israeli-sovereignty-golan-heights-190325153937336.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Syria]]'s [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates (Syria)|Foreign Affairs Ministry]] condemns Trump's move as a "flagrant violation of the sovereignty of Syria". [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-03/26/c_137923014.htm (Xinhuanet)]
*[[Greek–Turkish relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Greece|Greek prime minister]] [[Alexis Tsipras]] says [[Turkish Air Force|Turkish fighter jets]] threatened his helicopter, in Greek [[airspace]], heading to the [[Aegean Islands|Aegean island]] of [[Agathonisi]], near Turkey's coastline, for [[Greek Independence Day]]  which celebrates the country's [[Greek War of Independence|1821 uprising]] against the  [[Ottoman Empire]]. [[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish security forces]] rejected the accusation, insisting the jets were carrying out a routine mission. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47692529 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*A judge rules that former [[Guantanamo Bay detention camp|Guantanamo Bay]] prisoner [[Omar Khadr]] has completed his prison sentence. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.5068610 (CBC)] [https://www.vancourier.com/edmonton-judge-rules-omar-khadr-s-sentence-has-expired-1.23769542 (Vancouver Courier)]
*Attorney [[Michael Avenatti]] is arrested and charged with extortion, embezzlement and bank fraud. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/25/michael-avenatti-to-be-charged-with-wire-and-bank-fraud.html (CNBC)]
